suggestions.topic: EIP-8365 CFI decision with reduced scope (block new 0x00 deposits only)
suggestions.rationale: Deferred from ACDC #187 with explicit expectation to revisit at next ACDC. Author NC committed to updating PR to remove forced exits before this call.

suggestions.topic: Sepolia Glamsterdam fork retrospective and Hoodi go/no-go
suggestions.rationale: Sepolia fork occurred October 6 (22 days ago). ACDC #187 set go/no-go decision for Hoodi (tentatively October 27) to occur on ACD October 8, which has passed. Status update needed for both testnets.

suggestions.topic: Builder circuit breaker implementation status verification
suggestions.rationale: ACDC #187 assigned action to all CL teams before testnet forks. Sepolia has forked; Hoodi fork imminent. potuz warned of DOS risk from fake builders on testnets. Confirmation needed.

suggestions.topic: EIP-8411 CFI decision (Fast Execution Payload Broadcast)
suggestions.rationale: PFI'd in ACDC #187; CFI decision explicitly deferred until after other pending CFI decisions were resolved. Those decisions (8015, 8365, DFIs) have now been made.

suggestions.topic: EIP-8148/8205 CFI/DFI discussion (custom sweep thresholds + withdrawal credential pre-registration)
suggestions.rationale: Deferred from ACDC #186 with expected revisit in ~2 weeks (around September 17). Specs and POC ready. Has been 11 days since last call.

suggestions.topic: EIP-8363 community input process and next steps
suggestions.rationale: Tabled in ACDC #187 after 3 clients DFI'd, 3 abstained. stokes committed to proposing a process for broader community input before next ACDC. Decision framework needed.

suggestions.topic: Hegota devnet planning and EIP scope finalization
suggestions.rationale: Multiple CFI/DFI decisions made in ACDC #187. With Glamsterdam testnets now live, next phase should include Hegota devnet timeline, remaining EIP scoping, and implementation sequencing.

suggestions.topic: Production builder fork transition testing lessons from testnets
suggestions.rationale: ACDC #187 noted production builders (Titan, Ultrasound) have never been tested through a fork. Hoodi was planned as test venue. Results and implications for mainnet should be discussed.
